boundary.note: Triggers wake MC and produce events/recommendation inputs. They do not directly mutate external systems.

triggers.condition: User mentions MorroWise, 活系統, system-ops, Jarvis, or asks why the system keeps patching one piece at a time.
triggers.next_step: Find existing task anchor before execution; create/update task if no owner exists.

triggers.condition: Weekly review, daily closing, or heartbeat asks what changed and what requires attention.
triggers.next_step: Summarize evidence and produce recommendation candidates; do not execute actions yet.

triggers.condition: A task is blocked, newly blocked, stale after inactivity, or repeatedly appears in Sentinel attention.
triggers.next_step: Classify owner, missing dependency, missing decision, duplicate legacy task, or approval wait.

triggers.condition: Completed work appears in the worktree, but commit boundary or task completion fields are missing.
triggers.next_step: Run commit boundary gate: verify, stage intended scope, commit, then update task state.

triggers.condition: Task event reducer reports rejected events or rejected_by_reason count increases.
triggers.next_step: Inspect rejected reason, repair event or source task, then rerun reducer/generator.

triggers.condition: Sync event failed, sync pending is too old, dry-run mismatch exists, or legacy fallback was used.
triggers.next_step: Prefer dry-run parity; request Vincent approval before external write if policy requires it.

triggers.condition: A new Agent session starts inside $COLLAB for Vincent/HiSenzi/Codex collaboration work.
triggers.next_step: Resolve $COLLAB, read required startup docs, confirm task anchor before work.

triggers.condition: A project exists without goals/risks/success criteria, a valid tasks.json, or at least one executable task anchor.
triggers.next_step: Create or repair project/task anchor before implementation begins.

triggers.condition: Markdown status, dashboard state, generated data, Heptabase, or Canvas disagree with tasks.json.
triggers.next_step: Use tasks.json as current state; update docs or generated data, or record an open loop.

triggers.condition: Tracked task is missing Heptabase card_id, synced_at, Canvas mirror evidence, or visual refs disagree with MC source.
triggers.next_step: Request visual-layer sync or coverage report; do not close task from visual layer alone.

triggers.condition: An approval-required action is waiting too long, or an Agent attempts approval-required work.
triggers.next_step: Stop before side effect and surface exact requested action to Vincent.
